name: Minimum Largest Order-Shattered Set of the Order-Shattering/Effective-VC-Radius Separation Class
proof: For each of the six coordinate orders, standard downshifting produces a downset with a two-element face; hence every order has an order-shattered two-set. The class has five concepts, so no shifted class can contain a three-cube. Thus the minimum largest order-shattered-set size is two. All orders are checked by $\texttt{sync/verify\_order\_shattering\_separation.py}$.
